procedure_file: extraction_procedure_social_addendum_v1.4_social science Classes 6-10 on top of procedure v2.md

second_method.method: printed BLUE PRINT difficulty table total (Easy 10 + Average 13 + Difficulty 03 = 26), pdf 10; independently, the answer side prints 26 keys 1-26

count_gate.note: Question side labels 1-26 monotonic, no gaps, no duplicates (I 1-10, II 11-16, III 17-20, IV 21-23, V 24-26); answer side keys 1-26 in the same order. BLUE PRINT total 26 = audited count (quota_table difficulty_only, addendum §8). Section headers print 'NxM=T' with N disagreeing with the printed rows in III ('5X1=5' over 4 rows) and IV ('5 X 1 = 5' over 3 questions) — blueprint totals, not counts. Difficulty per question: easy 0, average 0, difficult 0, untagged 26.

method_notes: Pages: Q side heading + LO table + BLUE PRINT pdf 10, q1-2 pdf 10, q3-10 pdf 11 (q10 options on pdf 12), q11-20 pdf 12, q21-26 pdf 13. A side 'Key Answers: / Lesson :- 1: A Day in the garden' pdf 98, keys 1-26 pdf 98 (q26 key continues to pdf 99 top). Folios printed = pdf page (offset 0).

BILINGUAL: every English line is followed by its Kannada line. On the question side the Kannada extracts as Unicode Kannada (broken shaping); on the answer side two lines (III and IV keys, pdf 98) extract as legacy-Nudi Latin junk. ALL Kannada lines dropped; nothing Kannada or Nudi stored (junk grep and Unicode-Kannada grep both 0).

Sections (roman numerals printed; -sN- by printed order, numeral kept in section_signal): s1 I mcq q1-10; s2 II 'Identify the relationship and answer' q11-16 analogies with a printed blank -> fill by form; s3 III match q17-20 printed as four numbered rows -> four one-pair match questions (printed labels rule, as evs-4-06, control rev 3); s4 IV fill-from-box q21-23 (box words kept in the stem as printed); s5 V answer q24-26 -> sa by form (2-3 sentence/line keys).

MARKS (ruling R-E9, control rev 2): header 'N x M = T' gives marks M (section_header) only when N = the printed question count of the section, N*M = T and M is the smaller factor. s1 '10X1=10' (10 q) -> 1; s2 '6x1=6' (6 q) -> 1; s5 '3X3=9' (3 q) -> 3; s3 '5X1=5' over 4 rows and s4 '5 X 1 = 5' over 3 questions -> null + 'unassigned' + 'marks ambiguous in source — <reason>'. (v1 rev of this file applied the prompt pin, null everywhere; changed before the batch tag as ruled.)

DIFFICULTY: no per-question or section tag anywhere -> difficulty null, 'unassigned', 'no difficulty tag' on all 26. BLUE PRINT totals (E10/A13/D3) recorded in the subject map and count_gate only; no backfill.

MATCH III: column A Birds/Duck/Cow/Cat, column B Moo/Mew/chirps/quack (unlettered); key prints the right-hand value per number ('17. chirping 18. Quack 19 moo 20. Mew') -> pair left = the row's column-A item, right = key wording verbatim; q17 'chirping' vs column-B 'chirps' flagged. Stem = 'Match the following: <A item>' + column B list.

KEYS: MCQ letter+text; letter kept (addendum §4.1). q7 key 'C) Ant' vs option C 'Gut' and q8 'B) Screaming sweetly' vs option B 'melodious' -> 'key text paraphrases option' (the Kannada line printed under option and key is the same word in each case; q7 = anthill). q5 'Weaver bird' vs 'Weaver Bird' case only. Analogy keys q11 'scurries' and q14 'roars' contradict fact (frog hops; elephant trumpets — the keys' own Kannada lines say so) -> 'printed key contradicts fact' (review-blocking, v1.4 §14.6). q24/q25 one paragraph each (wrapped over 2 lines, joined); q26 three printed lines (one per class) -> 3 solution_steps.
Source typos kept verbatim: q2 option B 'Knob', q5 option D 'Cucko', q10 'a omnivore', q13 'Laya', q22 'jellyf ish', q23 'eats', key q22 'Acquatic animals', key q23 'Omnivore’s'.

LO (ruling R-E10): the lesson prints one LO row (LO No. 1) applicable to the whole lesson -> learning_outcomes [{number '1', text_as_printed = the English LO text}] with lo_source 'lesson_table' (lesson-level provenance, not a per-question mapping) on every question; no 'no LO mapped' flag. TOPIC: evs-3-01-t00 / chapter / high on all (R-E3; map v1 evs-3-01 has exactly t00).
FIGURES: pdfimages lists no image on pdf 10-13 or 98-99; pdfplumber finds no curves (rects = LO/BLUE PRINT tables). No picture-based question; no stimuli.
